dpo: OUT OF SCOPE - not prepared, launched, evaluated, or budgeted

base_versus_sft_on_locked_validation.interpretation: SFT helps by roughly +1.3 points at best on held-out validation, an order of magnitude less than the 100-function monitor panel implied, and one trained adapter was net worse than the untrained base.

actual_atheris_same_targets.interpretation: On the same 757 validation targets Oneiros beats real Atheris at both budgets, including when Atheris is given 2,500x the executions AND the reference implementation for a differential oracle.

prompt_compaction.limitation: About a third of repository prompts do not fit the frozen 1024-token budget and fail closed, so they are absent from every repository result.

non_llm_baseline_bundle.seed_sensitivity: deterministic arms (static, dataset_tests) have zero spread; the stochastic coverage arm has the largest, so comparisons against it need all three seeds
non_llm_baseline_bundle.protocol: same targets, candidate budget, timeout, seeds, validity and kill rules as the model arms
non_llm_baseline_bundle.advantage_given_to_baselines: every generative baseline derives its expected value by executing the reference implementation, so each has a perfect oracle and need only choose inputs. Oneiros never sees the reference.
non_llm_baseline_bundle.naming: the coverage arm is a SIMULATED coverage fuzzer written for this project and is never reported as Atheris

shape_policy_is_not_doing_the_work.interpretation: rescoring the stored base generations under the widened test-function rule admitted no additional candidate on any seed, so the widened policy confers no baseline-side advantage and cannot explain a gap between the arms.

final_sft_adapter.detail: The final source-bound rebuild on verified multi-mutant supervision must complete and be receipted before any final claim about the selected adapter.

relearning_challenger.detail: The relearning dataset is built and hashed. No relearning adapter has been trained, so there is no base-vs-SFT-vs-relearning comparison yet.

swebench_expansion.detail: SWE-bench ingestion runs the official harness on Modal and no Modal token is configured, removing 114 otherwise eligible instances.

native_generated_test_execution.detail: The native pilot reproduces the OFFICIAL test on 3 of 5 BugsInPy defects. No model-generated test has been run natively, so repository records remain verified supervision coverage.

balance_parity_unreachable.detail: 50/50 by unique semantic target needs 317 more repository targets. The optimistic ceiling is 304 and the expected yield 182, so parity is not reachable from available data.

complexity_floor.detail: The 0.60 complex-example floor is a design choice. It has not been shown to improve results and is not claimed to.

checkpoint_instability.detail: Best checkpoint differed across seeds (50, 142, 142). Checkpoint 50 is not universally optimal.

base_model_choice.detail: Qwen was selected because Phi-3 cannot use SDPA in the pinned transformers build. That is a feasibility constraint, not evidence that Qwen beats a fully trained Phi-3 in a controlled comparison.

balanced corpus: need 317 more unique repository targets for parity
balanced corpus: repository project concentration exceeds the frozen cap
balanced corpus: the aspirational 0.60 complex-only floor is not met
